rows.name: The Venetian Resort
rows.poker_room: The Palazzo, level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes
rows.note: Official poker page: 50 tables, open 24 hours, complimentary self-parking for players who play three hours or more. The street address is not printed on the official pages read in this session.

rows.name: Wynn Las Vegas
rows.poker_room: Wynn Las Vegas poker room, located in Encore at Wynn Las Vegas
rows.address: 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. S., Las Vegas, NV 89109
rows.note: Official tournament terms place the poker room in Encore. The official poker page links the WPT, Wynn Signature Series and daily tournament schedules, structures and results. Registration opening time: the official Wynn daily tournament terms and conditions state "Registration for each Event will open four (4) hours prior to the scheduled start of play", so a 12 p.m. daily event opens registration at 8 a.m. That opening time is printed only in the Wynn daily tournament terms; the WPT and Signature Series schedule PDFs print a registration CLOSE time per event but no opening time.

rows.name: ARIA Resort & Casino
rows.poker_room: ARIA poker room, east side of the casino floor next to main valet pick-up
rows.note: Official ARIA poker page (read 2026-11-17): 24 tables and exclusive room rates for qualifying poker players, by phone 702.590.7232 or e-mail PokerRoomRates@aria.com. The page says the Daily Tournaments run "as scheduled" but publishes no schedule, buy-in or structure, and tells guests to call the room or follow @ARIAPoker. No ARIA tournament row is listed because no official schedule or structure sheet was read.

rows.name: Bellagio
rows.poker_room: Bellagio poker room, northside of the casino next to the Sportsbook (official poker page)
rows.note: Official Bellagio poker page (read 2026-11-17) links three weekly tournament flyers. None prints a calendar date, so no dated row is listed. Friday $600 NLH, 11:00 a.m.: $510 prize pool, $50 house fee, $40 optional staff gratuity; rule 3 says players "may buy-in and re-enter through the end of level 8", so it is a re-entry event and not single entry. Saturday, 11:00 a.m.: the flyer heading says a $1,100 buy-in, the page label and file name say $1,000, and rule 7 refers to a "$600 Buy-in"; flight rules say each flight plays until the money. Its entry rule is not confirmed. Sunday $400 H.O.R.S.E., 11:00 a.m.: $340 prize pool, $35 house fee, $25 optional gratuity; rule 5 says "buy-in and re-enter through the end of level 8", so it is not single entry. The page notice "Tournament play will resume on Saturday, July 26" does not match the calendar: July 26, 2026 is a Sunday. The flyers are hosted on a CMS domain that is not on the approved list, so they are cited through the official page.

rows.name: Caesars Palace
rows.poker_room: The Poker Room at Caesars Palace, Appian Way promenade (16 tables per official article)
rows.address: 3570 Las Vegas Blvd South, Las Vegas, NV 89109
rows.note: Official Caesars article dated 2026-07-17 (read 2026-11-17) says the room is open 24/7 and runs four no-limit hold'em tournaments a day at 10 a.m., 2 p.m., 6 p.m. and 9 p.m. with a $100 buy-in, 20,000 starting chips and a $1,000 guarantee, plus a $50 add-on at the first break for 15,000 chips. Because of that add-on the format is not single entry and belongs in the separate section; no rank is given. The article is editorial, not a structure sheet, so no row is created. The same article lists six daily games at Horseshoe Las Vegas (9 a.m., 11 a.m., 2 p.m., 5 p.m., 8 p.m., 11 p.m.), which are not in this dataset.
